content: Yudɑbɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ nuɑ mɑ be bɑ rɑɑ yoru mwɛɛrɑ bɑ wurɑmɑ bɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni sɑ̃ɑ yeru bɑniɑmmɛ.

Yerɑ yibɛrɛ be, bɑ nɑ Sorobɑbɛli kɑ Yudɑbɑn bukurobun mi bɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ko kɑ bɛɛ bɑnɑ ye ko, domi bɛsɛn tii sɑ rɑ Gusunɔ bɛɛn Yinni sɑ̃, kpɑ su nùn yɑ̃kuru kuɑ sɑɑ Esɑri Hɑdoni, Asirin sinɑ bokon wɑɑtin di, wi, wi u kɑ sun nɑ mini.
Adɑmɑ Sorobɑbɛli kɑ Yosue kɑ Isirelibɑn yɛnu yɛ̃ro be bɑ tie, bɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, n ǹ kɑ bɛɛ, bɛsɛ tɔnɑwɑ nɡe mɛ Sirusi Pɛɛsibɑn sinɑ boko u ɡeruɑ. Domi Gusunɔ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn Yinnin sɑ̃ɑ yerɑ.
Sɑɑ yerɑ tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, bɑ Yudɑbɑn dɑm buɑ. Mɑ bɑ bu nɑndɑsiɑ bu ku kɑ bɑnɑ ye ko.
Bɑ bwisi kɛ̃ɔbu ɡɑbu ɡobi kɑ̃ bu kɑ tɔmbu swɑɑ nim wiɑ bu kɑ sɔmbu te kpɑnɑ. Nɡe mɛyɑ n koorɑ Sirusin bɑndun wɑɑti kpuro sɔɔ, sere n kɑ ɡirɑri Dɑrusi Pɛɛsibɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndu sɔɔ.
Bɑ Yudɑbɑ kɔrumɔtɔnu kuɑ
Asuresin bɑndun tore sɔɔ, bɑ tireru yoruɑ bu kɑ Yudɑbɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃.
Aɑtɑsɛsi Pɛɛsin sinɑ bokon wɑɑti sɔɔ, Bisilɑmu kɑ Miteredɑti kɑ Tɑbɛɛli kɑ sere ben sɔm kowosibu bɑ Aɑtɑsɛsi wi tireru yoruɑ. Bɑ tu yoruɑwɑ kɑ Arɑmun bɑrum kɑ mɛn yorɑ.
Rehumu, berɑ min kpɑro kɑ win tire yoro Simusɑi bɑ sinɑ boko Aɑtɑsɛsi tire te yoruɑ te tɑ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ̃.

Wee ye tire te, tɑ ɡeruɑ. Tɑ nɛɛ, Aɑtɑsɛsi, sinɑ boko, bɛsɛ wunɛn sɔm kowobu, bɛsɛ be sɑ wɑ̃ɑ dɑɑ ɡuru ɡee, nɛ, Rehumu, berɑ minin kpɑro kɑ Simusɑi nɛn tire yoro kɑ sere bɛsɛn sɔm kowosibu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Diniɔ kɑ Aɑfɑsɑtɑkiɔ kɑ Tɑɑpɛliɔ kɑ Afɑrɑsiɔ kɑ Erɛkiɔ kɑ Bɑbiloniɔ kɑ Susiɔ kɑ Dehɑɔ kɑ Elɑmuɔ kɑ sere bwese ni nu tie ni Asinɑpɑri wi u sɑ̃ɑ tɔn boko u swĩi Sɑmɑriɔ kɑ sere wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ Efɑrɑtin ɡuru ɡee, sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ, bɛsɛrɑ sɑ nun yoruɑmmɛ. Sɑ nɛɛ,

sinɑ boko, ɑ de ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ Yuu be bɑ nɑ sɑɑ wunɛn min di bɑ tunumɑ bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ Yerusɑlɛmu mini. Bɑ nɑ bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu ye seeyɑ yèn tɔmbɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ ku rɑ mɛm nɔ mi. Bɑ yen ɡbɑ̃rɑrun kpɛɛkpɛɛku sɔmmɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ bɑ̀ n wuu ɡen ɡbɑ̃rɑru seeyɑ, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ wɔ̃ɔ ɡobi kɔsiɑmɔ ǹ kun mɛ ɡbererun ɡobi. Yen biru wunɛn ɑrumɑni ye ɑ rɑ rɑɑ wɑ yɑ koo kɑɑrɑwɑ.
Nɡe mɛ sɑ mɑɑ wɑɑmɔ sɑ dimɔ wunɛn min di, yerɑ sɑ nɛɛ, n ǹ weenɛ bu nun ɡɛm. Yen sɔ̃nɑ sɑ nun lɑbɑɑri yeni sɔ̃ɔmɔ.

A de ɑ kɑsu wunɛn sikɑdobɑn fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ, kɑɑ wɑ nɡe mɛ Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wuu ɡe ɡɑ rɑ sinɑmbu seesi kɑ sere berɑ mi yɑ wɑ̃ɑn tɔmbu. Sɑɑ yellun diyɑ yɑ rɑ ko mɛ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ ye bɑnsu koosiɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, wunɛ sinɑ boko, ɑ̀ n wurɑ wuu ɡe, ɡɑ bɑnirɑ, mɑ bɑ ɡen ɡbɑ̃rɑru seeyɑ, ɑ ǹ kɑɑ mɑɑ Efɑrɑtin dɑɑ ɡuru ɡe nɔmɑ sikerenɑ ɑ n mɔ.
Sinɑ boko Aɑtɑsɛsin wisibu

Sinɑ boko Aɑtɑsɛsi u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, Rehumu, wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ berɑ yen kpɑro, kɑ wunɛn tire yoro Simusɑi kɑ bɛɛn sɔm kowosibu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Sɑmɑriɔ kɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Efɑrɑtin dɑɑrun ɡuru ɡiɔ, bɛɛ kpurowɑ nɑ tɔburɑ.
Tire te i mɑn mɔrisiɑmɑ mi, bɑ mɑn tu ɡɑriɑ mɑm mɑm.
Mɑ nɑ woodɑ wɛ̃ bu kɑsu nɛn sikɑdobɑn fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ. Mɑ bɑ kɑso ɡe kuɑ bɑ wɑ mɑ sɑɑ yellun di wuu ɡe, ɡɑ rɑ sinɑmbun woodɑ yinɛ kpɑ bɑ n bu seesimɔ.
Yerusɑlɛmu mi, sinɑm dɑmɡibɑ bɑ bɑndu di mɑ bɑ beri min tem kpuro mɔ. Mɑ sinɑmbu ɡɑbu bɑ rɑ bu wɔ̃ɔ ɡobi kɑ ɡbere ɡobi kɔsie.
Yen sɔ̃, i tɔn ben sɔmburu yɔ̃rɑsio kpɑ bu ku rɑɑ wuu ɡen bɑnsu seeyɑ mɑ n kun mɔ nɑ bu woodɑ wɛ̃.
I ku ɡɑri yi ɑtɑfiiru ko kpɑ kɔ̃sɑ yu ku rɑɑ sosi yu kɑ sinɑmbu ɑsɔrɔ nɑɑwɑ.
Ye bɑ yɑnde Aɑtɑsɛsin tire te wɑ, bɑ ɡɑrɑ Rehumu kɑ win tire yoro Simusɑi kɑ sere ben sɔm kowosibun wuswɑɑɔ, yerɑ bɑ dɑ fuuku Yerusɑlɛmuɔ Yuubɑn mi, bɑ ben sɔmbu te yɔ̃rɑsiɑ kɑ dɑm.
Bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun
bɑnɑn sɔmburu seewɑ
Sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔmbu te, tɑ yɔ̃rɑ n kɑ kuɑ Dɑrusi Pɛɛsibɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ yiruse sɔɔ.
